analysis: Examined head_text units for fixtures/prompt-contract/v1/production_vectors.json lines 5074-6861: the tail of a token_ids array (repeated 6297 tokens ending with the template suffix at 5833-5839), plus the multi_system, nulls, reasoning_effort and response_text vectors. These head lines fall outside the changed ranges listed in file_changes (head changes are at 3020-3038, 3805-3926, 4752-4754, 43739+, ...), so they are unchanged context. The patch excerpt shows the changed vectors adding additional_context.enable_thinking=false and updating prompt_token_count from 803 to 767, with new chain_hash/last_complete_block_hash values. The fixtures contain only public synthetic content: no secrets, keys or real consumer data (A-001). Prefix-cache chain hashes relate to T-041 cache keying, but they are golden vectors and not an enforcement path. No authorization, attestation (TB-011), transport (TB-002) or encryption behavior changes in these units. Integration should confirm that the provider- and coordinator-side prompt-contract implementations agree with the updated vectors. Of security note: enable_thinking handling must not let a consumer-controlled additional_context shift cache block boundaries in a cross-tenant-observable way (T-041). That is a correctness/parity question outside this batch's evidence. No regression identified.
